description: Feature-validate exits with distinct wording when dev-{N}.json is missing AND git agrees the tree/branch is genuinely empty.
failure_mode: Model reports the old generic 'missing context file' message instead of distinguishing 'stage never ran' from 'context malformed', or fabricates progress instead of exiting.
prompt: Phase 0 of feature-validate finds .nightgauge/pipeline/dev-134.json missing. You run `nightgauge gate verify feature-dev 134 --workdir . --json` and it reports a clean working tree with no commits ahead of base (no terminal_kind of dev_handoff_missing). What do you do?

assertions.pattern: (no git evidence|no implementation work|has not produced anything|exit)
